audit_notes: correct.jp 冒頭の a の根拠「電子メールのウイルスは受信者のアドレス帳を利用して感染者本人が気付かないまま知人へ送信され」で、主語が『受信者』と『感染者』で揺れており、誰のアドレス帳が悪用されるのかが一読で曖昧。同じ解説の distractors.エ では「感染者のアドレス帳を悪用して」と明確に書けているので、correct.jp も『感染した人 (＝差出人) のアドレス帳』と揃えるのが望ましい。zh も「会利用收件人的通讯录，在感染者本人毫无察觉的情况下」と同じ揺れを忠実に踏襲、en は "may use the recipient address book" と所有格 (recipient's) も落ちていて読みにくい。内容自体は誤りではなく、正解 ア の導出には影響しない cosmetic な明瞭性の問題。

fields.correct: The correct answer is ア. Only a and b are appropriate. First, regarding a, an email virus may use the recipient address book to send itself to acquaintances without the infected person noticing, or it may arrive disguised as a trusted party through spoofing of the sender address. In other words, who the mail came from is no guarantee at all that the attachment is safe, so performing a virus check on the attachment even when the mail is from a person you trust is appropriate. Next, regarding b, non-executable files such as audio or images look safe at first glance, but there is a technique of faking the file extension so that the file is in fact an executable, and there are also cases where malicious data that exploits a vulnerability in the application opening the file is embedded in an image or document data file itself, so that a malicious program starts running the moment the file is opened. Therefore performing a virus check regardless of the type of file is appropriate. On the other hand, c is clearly wrong: the preview function automatically interprets and displays the body of a message without any action to open it, so a script or a malicious tag embedded in an HTML mail, or external content that is loaded automatically, can run and infect the machine merely from previewing. Far from being a way to confirm safety, it can itself become the trigger for an infection, so the correct handling of a suspicious email is to delete it without opening it, preview included. Hence only a and b are appropriate, and ア, which lists exactly those and nothing else, is the correct answer.
fields.d:イ: This option is wrong in treating a, b and c as all appropriate. The judgments on a and b are correct, but c, which says to use the preview function of the mail software to confirm the safety of the content of a suspicious email before opening it, is not appropriate. Preview is a mechanism that automatically interprets and displays the message body, so a script planted in an HTML mail can already run before the message is read, which means preview cannot serve as a way to confirm safety. Because it includes the inappropriate c, this option does not satisfy the condition of listing only and all of the appropriate items.
fields.d:ウ: This option makes two mistakes: it drops the appropriate b and includes the inappropriate c. Even for non-executable files such as audio or images there are attacks that fake the file extension or exploit a vulnerability in the file format, so b is an appropriate measure that calls for a virus check and must not be excluded. In addition, counting the confirmation of safety by preview (c), which can itself become the trigger for an infection, as appropriate is also wrong.
fields.d:エ: This option makes two mistakes: it drops the appropriate a and includes the inappropriate c. A virus may abuse the address book of an infected person and arrive while impersonating an acquaintance, and the fact that the sender is someone you trust guarantees nothing about the safety of the attachment, so a is a necessary measure and cannot be excluded. In addition, regarding the confirmation of safety by preview (c) as appropriate is also wrong.
fields.p:0: The principle of protecting against email-borne viruses — an attachment must always be virus-checked, no matter whether the sender can be trusted and no matter whether the attachment is in an executable format. A virus may arrive disguised as a trusted party through spoofing or through abuse of an address book, and there are also attacks that fake the file extension or exploit a vulnerability in the application that handles a data file such as an image, an audio file or a document, so safety must not be judged from appearance.
fields.p:1: The danger of the preview function — the preview (preview pane) of mail software is a function that automatically interprets and displays the message body, so a script planted in an HTML mail or external content that is loaded automatically can infect the machine merely from viewing it. It therefore cannot serve as a way to confirm safety; the correct handling of a suspicious email is to delete it without opening it, preview included. Learn this together with keeping the virus definition file up to date as a basic countermeasure.
fields.stem:
Which option lists only and all of the appropriate precautions to take in order to avoid harm from a virus spread via email?
a Perform a virus check on an attachment even if the email is from a person you trust.
b Perform a virus check even if the type of attachment is a non-executable file such as audio or an image.
c For a suspicious email, use the preview function of the mail software to confirm the safety of its content before opening it.

audit_notes: en に所有格脱落による非文がある。points[0].en「the company own abilities and resources」は正しくは「the company's own abilities and resources」。correct.en も「the company strengths」「S Company strengths」と所有格を落としている。同 exam の他問 en では所有格アポストロフィが計 46 箇所使用されており house style ではなく、本問固有の欠陥。加えて en 本文は〔S Company situation〕と JP 括弧＋独自ラベルを使うが、配信中の en stem は「[Situation of Company S]」であり、括弧種・ラベルとも不一致 (用語整合の低位 drift)。
en に所有格の欠落がある。『S Company strengths』『the company own abilities』は、それぞれ S Company's / the company's が正しい。また誤答アの en では、選択肢本文の『インターネットによる』が訳出されず『a mail-order sales system』だけになっている (zh は『互联网邮购销售系统』と訳出済み)。

fields.correct: Policy Plan 1 says to strengthen the information system in order to further extend the company strengths. What must be chosen, therefore, is a measure that uses an information system to further reinforce S Company strengths (in SWOT analysis, the positive factors of the internal environment). Among the items in 〔S Company situation〕, the ones that count as strengths are (3) product planning ability higher than that of competitors, and (8) the fact that turning customers into members has gathered customer information and has also succeeded in acquiring wealthy members. The CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system in choice イ is a mechanism that analyzes the accumulated purchase data of customers and provides finely tailored, attentive service to each individual member, thereby deepening the relationship with customers. This is exactly a measure that uses an information system to further extend the existing strength in (8), that membership has gathered customer information, and it matches Policy Plan 1. The correct answer is therefore イ.
fields.d:ア: Introducing a mail-order sales system that is not easily affected by the number of sales locations is a measure meant to make up for the weakness (a negative factor of the internal environment) in 〔S Company situation〕 (1), that the company has fewer sales locations than other companies. It overcomes a weakness rather than extending a strength, so it does not fit Policy Plan 1.
fields.d:ウ: Thoroughly enforcing safety management in the production process is a response to the threat (a negative factor of the external environment) in (7), that consumers have become stricter about food safety, and at the same time it takes care of the weakness in (5), the aging of the factory. It is a defensive measure, not a measure that further extends a strength.
fields.d:エ: A POS (Point Of Sales) system is a mechanism that collects and analyzes sales results such as the product, the quantity, and the time of day at the moment an item is sold at the register; it is not a mechanism for obtaining statistical data on the population distribution of each region (population statistics are external statistical data). The purpose and the means do not correspond. Furthermore, planning health snacks for adults is a response to the threat in (6), that the child population is decreasing as the birth rate falls, so it is not a measure that extends a strength either.
fields.p:0: Read 〔S Company situation〕 by sorting each item into the four categories of SWOT analysis. Strengths and weaknesses belong to the internal environment (the company own abilities and resources), while opportunities and threats belong to the external environment (changes in the market and in society). Policy Plan 1 in this question says to further extend a strength, so the answer is settled simply by judging whether each choice is a measure aimed at a strength, a weakness, an opportunity, or a threat.
fields.p:1: CRM is the idea, and the system that implements it, of analyzing information such as the purchase histories of customers, responding to each customer in a way suited to that individual, and thereby maintaining and strengthening a good relationship with customers so that it leads to revenue. Keep it distinct from POS, which collects sales results, from a production management system, which manages production plans and progress, and from a mail-order sales system, which widens sales channels: hold on to what purpose each system exists for.
fields.stem:
The planning department of Company S, a health food manufacturer, is working on strategy formulation for its health snack business. It has recognized the company's own situation by classifying it into the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats of a SWOT analysis, examined the strategy that should be adopted, and drawn up two policy plans.
The situation of Company S and the outline of the policy plans are as follows.

[Situation of Company S]
(1) The number of sales locations is smaller than that of other companies.
(2) Competing Company T has decided to withdraw from the health snack business.
(3) The company has higher product planning capability than competing companies.
(4) With the rise in health consciousness, interest in health foods is increasing.
(5) The aging of the factories is progressing.
(6) Due to the declining birthrate, the child population is decreasing.
(7) Consumers are becoming stricter in their scrutiny of food safety.
(8) By turning customers into members, customer information has been accumulated, and the company has also succeeded in acquiring affluent members.

[Outline of the Policy Plans]
Policy Plan 1: Strengthen the information system in order to further extend the company's strengths.
Policy Plan 2: Acquire the business from which Company T is withdrawing, in order to expand the company's own business.
　　　　　Over the past several years, the market share for health snacks has been: Company Q 25%, Company R 16%, Company S 12%, Company T 10%, and others 37%.

In line with Policy Plan 1, which of the following statements about measures to further strengthen the company's strengths is appropriate?
fields.c:ア: Introduce an Internet-based mail-order sales system that is not easily affected by the number of sales locations.
fields.c:イ: Analyze customers' purchase data and build a CRM system in order to provide members with finely tailored, attentive services.
fields.c:ウ: Overhaul the production management system in order to thoroughly enforce safety management in the product manufacturing process.
fields.c:エ: Introduce a POS system for the purpose of analyzing statistical data on the population distribution of each region when planning health snacks for adults.

audit_notes: correct.en の「net assets = the company own capital」は所有格が抜けており「the company's own capital」とすべき (文法上の表記誤り)。

fields.correct: The correct answer is エ, the consolidated balance sheet. A balance sheet (B/S) is a financial statement that shows, at one point in time — the closing date — how much property a company holds (assets) and how that property was funded (liabilities = capital raised from others, net assets = the company own capital), setting the two sides side by side; the relationship assets = liabilities + net assets always holds. The two features the question states, ‘presenting a comparison of assets, liabilities, and net assets as of the closing date’ and ‘showing the financial position’, are exactly the definition of a balance sheet. The question further asks about the consolidated financial statement a parent company prepares by treating the corporate group including its subsidiaries as a single entity, so the consolidated version — the consolidated balance sheet — is the answer. In short, the balance sheet shows financial position (a stock, the balances at one point in time) while the income statement shows operating results (a flow, the changes over one period); once you have that contrast in mind you can answer immediately.
fields.d:ア: The consolidated statement of changes in shareholders' equity shows why, and by how much, net assets (shareholders' equity and the like) increased or decreased during an accounting period. It traces the breakdown of changes such as new share issues, dividends from surplus, and the recording of net income for the period, so it is a statement about a period, and what it mainly covers is the net assets section. It is not a statement that compares assets, liabilities, and net assets at the single point in time of the closing date, so it is not appropriate.
fields.d:イ: The consolidated cash flow statement shows the increase or decrease in cash and cash equivalents during an accounting period, divided into three sections: operating activities, investing activities, and financing activities. Its purpose is to make the flow of funds clear, and although it does tell you about the group's cash situation, it is not a statement that lays out a comparison of assets, liabilities, and net assets as of the closing date — that is, the financial position itself — so it is wrong.
fields.d:ウ: The consolidated income statement matches revenues against expenses for an accounting period and shows, as the difference between them, how much profit (or loss) was earned. What it presents is the operating results of one period, not the financial position, and the items set against each other are revenues and expenses, not the assets, liabilities, and net assets named in the question, so it is not appropriate. Separate the two by their roles: financial position = balance sheet, operating results = income statement.
fields.p:0: The balance sheet (B/S) is the statement that shows the financial position at the one point in time of the closing date, presenting the two sides in the form assets = liabilities + net assets. When you see wording such as ‘as of the closing date’ and ‘financial position’, judge it to be the balance sheet.
fields.p:1: Organize financial statements by two questions: does it cover one point in time (a stock) or one period (a flow), and what does it show? Balance sheet = one point in time, financial position; income statement = one period, operating results; cash flow statement = one period, the change in cash; statement of changes in shareholders' equity = one period, the change in net assets. When a parent company prepares them treating the whole corporate group including its subsidiaries as one entity, each becomes its consolidated version.
fields.stem: Which consolidated financial statement shows the financial position of a corporate group by presenting, as of the closing date, a comparison of the assets, liabilities, and net assets of the group including the parent company and its subsidiaries?
fields.c:ア: Consolidated statement of changes in shareholders' equity

audit_notes: correct.en の "by sharing the provider facilities" は所有格が抜けている ("the provider's facilities" が自然)。意味は伝わる。

fields.correct: The correct answer is エ. A colocation service (housing) is a form of service in which users bring servers and communication equipment that they themselves have purchased and own into a data center operated by a provider and are allowed to install them there. What the provider supplies is the installation space itself: an earthquake-resistant building and racks, uninterruptible power supplies and on-site generators, dedicated air conditioning, security such as entry and exit control, 24-hour monitoring, and high-speed, redundant lines to the Internet. Purchasing the server hardware, and operating and managing the OS and applications that run on it, remain on the user side. The effect obtained is therefore that the costs of facilities such as a server room, and of high-capacity communication lines, which the company would otherwise have to prepare by itself in order to keep providing services with its own servers, can be reduced by sharing the provider facilities. エ, which states exactly this, is the most appropriate.
fields.d:ア: Reducing the costs related to the use, introduction, and updating of business applications is the effect of using an ASP or SaaS, in which the provider supplies the application software itself over the network. With colocation, what is rented from the provider is only the place to put the equipment and the lines; the users themselves procure the business applications to run on the server and carry out their introduction and version upgrades, so those costs do not go down.
fields.d:イ: Reducing even the purchase cost of servers is the effect of a hosting service (a rental server). With hosting, users rent and use servers owned by the provider, so they do not need to buy the equipment, and the operational workload such as dealing with hardware failures is also borne by the provider. In contrast, the servers placed in a colocation facility are owned by the users, so both the purchase cost and the operation of the equipment remain their burden. Only the part about network-related costs going down applies here, but because the reduction of server purchase costs and of operational workload does not hold, this is not the most appropriate choice.
fields.d:ウ: Avoiding the update work for the OS and office software itself is the effect of using SaaS or an ASP, where the provider maintains the software, or of desktop virtualization (thin clients), where software management is consolidated on the server side. With colocation, maintenance work such as applying patches to the OS and middleware of the servers you have placed there remains within the responsibility of the users, and update work on computers located inside the company has nothing at all to do with placing equipment in a data center.
fields.p:0: Tell colocation (housing) and hosting apart by asking who owns the server. In colocation, equipment owned by the user is installed in the provider facility and what is rented is the space, power, air conditioning, security, and lines, so what goes down is facility costs and line costs. In hosting, servers owned by the provider are rented, so server purchase costs and the operational workload for the equipment go down as well.
fields.p:1: Ways of using external services can be organized as layers of how much you leave to the provider: renting only the facility = colocation (housing), renting the server as well = hosting, renting the business application as well = ASP or SaaS. Once you judge which layer of costs the effect given in a choice acts on, you can pick the correct answer.
fields.stem: Which of the following is the most appropriate effect that can be obtained by using a colocation (housing) service?
fields.c:ア: It can reduce the costs related to the use, introduction, and updating of business applications.
fields.c:イ: It can reduce server purchase costs, operational workload, and network-related costs.
fields.c:ウ: It can avoid the work of updating the OS and office software on servers and in-house computers.
fields.c:エ: It can reduce the network and facility costs required to provide services using one's own servers.

audit_notes: en 訳で所有格アポストロフィが欠落。correct.en「at the shareholders meeting」、distractors.エ.en「a resolution of Company B shareholders meeting」。正しくは「the shareholders' meeting」「Company B's shareholders' meeting」。意味は通るが英文法上の瑕疵。

fields.correct: Blank b must be an action that strengthens blank a, so you pick the combination in which a and b hold a valid cause-and-effect relationship. When Company A acquires additional shares (b), the ratio of Company B shares it holds rises, and its voting rights at the shareholders meeting increase. A higher voting-rights ratio strengthens its influence over the appointment and dismissal of directors and over resolutions on important matters, so its managerial control (a) over Company B is strengthened. Holding more than 50% of the voting rights makes effective control possible, and this relationship is called a parent-subsidiary relationship. When the voting rights are roughly 20% or more but 50% or less, control is not reached; the relationship is regarded as one that can exert significant influence, and such a company is called an affiliated company, distinguished from a subsidiary. Therefore イ, with a = managerial control and b = acquiring additional shares, is the correct answer.
fields.d:ア: The term for a, “managerial control”, is itself appropriate, but b, “selling off part of the shares”, means letting go of shares already held, which reduces the shareholding ratio and the voting rights. Far from being a means of strengthening a, it is an action that weakens control, the exact opposite of the wording “an action to strengthen”, so this choice is wrong.
fields.d:ウ: The term for a, “shareholding ratio”, is itself appropriate, but b, “dispatching an auditor”, means sending in a person who audits how the directors carry out their duties, and it involves no buying or selling of shares. The shareholding ratio in a (the proportion of shares held) therefore does not change at all, so b is not a means of raising a and this choice is wrong. In addition, an auditor is in a position that handles operational and accounting audits, and holds no authority to control management itself.
fields.d:エ: The term for a, “shareholding ratio”, is itself appropriate, but b, “dispatching a director”, is a means of deepening involvement in management, not a way of acquiring additional shares, so the shareholding ratio in a does not change. Here too b is not a means of raising a, so this choice is wrong. Moreover, appointing a director requires a resolution of Company B shareholders meeting, so it is an action that becomes possible only after a high shareholding ratio is already held; the cause and the effect are reversed as well.
fields.p:0: The relationship between the shareholding ratio and managerial control: raising the voting-rights ratio by acquiring additional shares is the basic way to strengthen control over a company you have invested in. More than 50% of the voting rights makes the company a subsidiary (control), while roughly 20% or more but 50% or less makes it an affiliated company (significant influence); the two are distinguished.
fields.p:1: Understand the distinction that dispatching officers (directors or auditors) is a means of getting involved in management, not an action that changes the shareholding ratio itself. In combination fill-in-the-blank questions, it works well to narrow the four choices down mechanically along the single axis of whether b really is a means of strengthening a.
fields.stem:
Regarding the relationship between an investor and the company it invests in, which combination of words to fill in a and b in the following statement is appropriate?

As an action for Company A to strengthen its [ a ] over Company B, in which it has invested, there is [ b ].
fields.c:ア: a: managerial control / b: selling off part of the shares
fields.c:イ: a: managerial control / b: acquiring additional shares
fields.c:ウ: a: shareholding ratio / b: dispatching an auditor
fields.c:エ: a: shareholding ratio / b: dispatching a director

audit_notes: correct.en「add its own task time to that predecessor finish time」は所有格が抜けており、「that predecessor's finish time」とするのが自然 (文法上の軽微な点で、意味は忠実)。

fields.correct: The correct answer is イ (10.5 hours). The earliest time at which all the tasks finish can be found by adding up the earliest finish time of each task from the beginning. There are only two steps: (1) if a task has a single predecessor, add its own task time to that predecessor finish time; (2) if a task has several predecessors, first line up with the one that finishes latest, and then add. Working it out: ① finishes at 0.5 hours. ② takes 2 hours after ①, so it finishes at 2.5 hours, and ③ takes 1 hour after ①, so it finishes at 1.5 hours. ④ can start only after both ② and ③ are done, so it starts from the later of the two, 2.5 hours, takes 3 hours, and finishes at 5.5 hours. After ④, tasks ⑤, ⑥ and ⑦ can all start at the same time, so ⑤ finishes at 7.5 hours, ⑥ at 8.5 hours, and ⑦ at 7.0 hours. The last task ⑧ waits until all three are done, so it starts from the latest one, ⑥ at 8.5 hours, takes 2 hours, and finishes at 10.5 hours. The earliest overall finish time is therefore 10.5 hours. This matches the total of the longest path ①→②→④→⑥→⑧ (0.5+2+3+3+2).
fields.d:ア: 10 hours is the value you get if you forget to count the first task ① (Stop the system), which takes 0.5 hours (2+3+3+2 = 10). Because ① has no predecessor, it starts as soon as the work begins, but it is explicitly listed as the predecessor of ② and ③, so neither ② nor ③ can start until ① is finished. A task at the very start still has to be added into the total time, so this value is 0.5 hours shorter than the correct one.
fields.d:ウ: 11 hours is the value you get if you treat ⑤ (2 hours) and ⑦ (1.5 hours) after ④ as being done one after the other and add 2+1.5 = 3.5 hours on top of the 5.5 hours at which ④ finishes (5.5+3.5+2 = 11). However, ⑤, ⑥ and ⑦ all have ④ as their only predecessor, so all three can be started at the same time once ④ is finished. What determines the start of ⑧ is whichever of the three finishes latest, namely ⑥ at 8.5 hours; there is no need to chain ⑤ and ⑦ in series and add them up.
fields.d:エ: 11.5 hours is the total of a path in which ② (2 hours) and ③ (1 hour) are treated as being done in sequence rather than in parallel (0.5+2+1+3+3+2 = 11.5). Both ② and ③ have ① as their only predecessor, so once ① is finished, backing up the system and extracting the migration data can proceed at the same time. What determines the start of ④ is the later of the two, the 2.5 hours at which ② finishes, not a wait of 2+1 = 3 hours. Counting tasks that can run in parallel as if they were in series makes the answer 1 hour too long.
fields.p:0: Forward pass for earliest finish times: the finish time of each task = the finish time of its predecessor + its own task time. A task with several predecessors cannot start until the latest of them is finished, so at a merge point you take the maximum value.
fields.p:1: Do not add up the times of tasks that can run in parallel (tasks that share the same predecessor). ② and ③ are in parallel, and so are ⑤, ⑥ and ⑦; what paces the whole project is the longest task in each branch (② and ⑥). Linking those gives ①→②→④→⑥→⑧, the critical path, and its length of 10.5 hours is the shortest possible completion time for the whole job.
fields.stem:
The information systems department of Company E is planning to introduce a new sales management system (hereinafter referred to as the new sales management system). F, a new employee in the information systems department, has been assigned to estimate the work time for the switchover work from the existing sales management system to the new sales management system, under the guidance of a senior colleague. The list of the work plan is shown in the table below.

Table: List of the work plan

| Task No. | Task item | Planned task time (hours) | Predecessor task No. |
|---|---|---|---|
| ① | Stop the system | 0.5 | None |
| ② | Back up the system | 2 | ① |
| ③ | Extract migration data | 1 | ① |
| ④ | Install software | 3 | ②, ③ |
| ⑤ | Configure system settings | 2 | ④ |
| ⑥ | Load migration data | 3 | ④ |
| ⑦ | Prepare the operation-check sheet | 1.5 | ④ |
| ⑧ | Operation check | 2 | ⑤, ⑥, ⑦ |

Mr. F calculated the earliest time at which all the tasks in the table can be completed. How many hours is that time?

audit_notes: distractors.ウ.en「a company internal procurement policy」「convey that case requirements」で所有格が抜けている (company's / that case's)。文法上の小さな誤りで、意味は伝わる。

fields.correct: The correct answer is エ (To request vendors to submit proposals and appropriately select the supplier to place the order with). An RFP (Request For Proposal) is a document prepared by the procuring side, that is, the organization that is acquiring a system or service. It compiles the business and system requirements to be realized, the preconditions, the budget and delivery-deadline limits, the contract conditions, and the items to be covered in the proposal along with its submission deadline, and is then presented to several candidate vendors to ask them to submit proposals. The procuring side compares and evaluates the proposals it receives on the same basis and selects the most suitable vendor as the supplier to place the order with. In other words, the very purpose of creating an RFP is to request proposals and choose the right supplier, so エ is the most appropriate.
fields.d:ア: An RFP may state the budget scale or an upper limit, but that is only supplementary information so that all proposals share the same preconditions. Amounts are what vendors present in their proposals and quotations; presenting an approximate outsourcing cost is not in itself the purpose of an RFP.
fields.d:イ: The document issued to broadly gather technology trends, feasibility, and product information for future system development is the RFI (Request For Information). The RFI is used at the stage before the RFP, so this choice mistakes the purpose of the RFI for that of the RFP.
fields.d:ウ: Standardizing procurement methods and procedures such as in-house development, outsourcing development, and product purchasing is the role of a company internal procurement policy, procurement rules, or guidelines. An RFP is prepared for each individual procurement case in order to convey that case requirements to vendors, so standardizing procedures is not its purpose.
fields.p:0: RFP (Request For Proposal) = a document in which the procuring side states its requirements and conditions and asks vendors to submit proposals. Its purpose is to compare and evaluate the proposals and appropriately select the supplier.
fields.p:1: The procurement flow is: RFI (request for information) → RFP (request for proposal) → receiving proposals and quotations → evaluation and vendor selection → contract. Remember the difference in roles: the RFI gathers information, while the RFP requests proposals.
fields.stem: Which of the following is the most appropriate purpose for creating an RFP?
fields.c:ア: To present the approximate outsourcing cost to vendors when outsourcing development.
fields.c:イ: To obtain information about the most suitable advanced technologies for future system development.
fields.c:ウ: To standardize procurement procedures such as in-house development, outsourcing development, and product purchasing.
fields.c:エ: To request vendors to submit proposals and appropriately select the supplier to place the order with.

audit_notes: イの en 訳「how the users side runs」はアポストロフィ抜け (users' side) の表記揺れ。

fields.correct: In the planning process, the most upstream stage of the system life cycle, the system planning is formulated on the basis of the system concept. What is clarified here is: which operations and functions to systematize (the scope of systematization), the overall development schedule, and the costs and benefits used to judge whether the investment is worthwhile (cost-effectiveness). Option エ lists exactly these three points—the functions to be systematized, the development schedule, and the costs and benefits—so it is correct as a deliverable of the planning process.
fields.d:ア: The migration procedures for switching to the new operations and the methods for training users are handled in the migration and operation preparation stage (the operation process or the migration plan), after development is finished and the system is cut over to production. They are not what is clarified in the planning stage.
fields.d:イ: The business procedures to be realized, the input/output information, and the business rules are business requirements that define how the users side runs its operations; they are clarified in the business requirements definition of the requirements definition process, not delivered by the planning process.
fields.d:ウ: The system functions and system configuration conditions necessary to realize the business requirements are the content of the system requirements definition, which takes the business requirements and fixes the specifications required of the system; it belongs to the development process, a stage downstream of the planning-stage system planning.
fields.p:0: The system planning of the planning process clarifies the scope of systematization (the functions to be systematized), the development schedule, and the cost-effectiveness.
fields.p:1: How the deliverables of each process are divided: planning = what to build / schedule / whether it pays off; requirements definition = business requirements (business procedures, rules); development (system requirements definition) = system functions and configuration; operation = migration, training.
fields.stem: When the system life cycle is divided into the planning process, requirements definition process, development process, operation process, and maintenance process, which of the following is the content that should be clarified in the system planning of the planning process?
fields.c:ア: The migration procedures for switching to the new operations, and the methods for training users
fields.c:イ: The business procedures to be realized in operations, the input/output information, and the business rules
fields.c:ウ: The system functions necessary to realize the business requirements, and the system configuration conditions
fields.c:エ: The functions to be systematized, the development schedule, and the costs and benefits

audit_notes: correct.en の "from the users point of view" はアポストロフィ欠落。正しくは "from the users' point of view" (または "from the user's point of view")。意味は通るが英文品質の瑕疵。

fields.correct: The correct answer is ウ, VPN (Virtual Private Network). A VPN is a technology that creates a communication path over a public line shared by an unspecified number of users, such as the Internet or a carrier network, by combining authentication, encryption, and tunneling (a mechanism that wraps communication data in another protocol to carry it), so that from the users point of view it looks like a closed line reserved just for them. Laying a physical leased line is expensive, but a VPN can reuse the existing public line while holding down the risk of eavesdropping and tampering, safely connecting sites to each other or connecting remote-work devices to the company LAN. This is exactly the description given in the question, “making a public line usable as if it were a dedicated line”.
fields.d:ア: ADSL is a subscriber access line technology that carries digital communication over metallic telephone lines (analog phone lines), with asymmetric upstream and downstream speeds. It is a transmission method for using a line faster, not a mechanism for creating a closed path equivalent to a dedicated line over a public line.
fields.d:イ: LAN (Local Area Network) refers to the on-premises network itself that connects a limited, small area such as an office or a home. It is a classification name based on the scale of a network, not a technology that makes a public line look like a dedicated line.
fields.d:エ: WAN (Wide Area Network) is a classification name for a wide-area network that links the LANs of distant sites through carrier lines. A VPN can be one of the means used when building a WAN, but WAN itself is not a term for the mechanism that makes a line look like a dedicated line.
fields.p:0: VPN = a technology that builds a virtual dedicated line over a public line (the Internet, etc.) by means of authentication, encryption, and tunneling. It achieves secure site-to-site and remote-work connections at a lower cost than laying a real leased line.
fields.p:1: LAN / WAN are classification names based on the “range” a network covers, while ADSL is a “transmission method” for the subscriber access line. Learn to distinguish whether a term is a network classification, an access line technology, or a security (virtual dedicated line) technology.
fields.stem: What is the name of the technology used to make a public line usable as if it were a dedicated (leased) line?

audit_notes: en の correct に「3 oclock」「5 oclock」「10 oclock」「12 oclock」「0 oclock」「6 oclock」が出てくるが、正しい綴りはアポストロフィ付きの o'clock。表記の誤りのみ。

fields.correct: The correct answer is “ウ Time of day”. An interval scale is one in which, beyond the magnitude and order of values, the intervals (differences) between graduations are equal and meaningful, but the origin (zero) is set merely for convenience, so ratios are not meaningful. For time of day, the interval of one hour is equal everywhere, and the difference between 3 oclock and 5 oclock (2 hours) carries the same meaning as the difference between 10 oclock and 12 oclock. On the other hand, 0 oclock is not an absolute zero but only a conventional reference point, so a ratio calculation such as “6 oclock is twice 3 oclock” is meaningless. The property that differences are meaningful while ratios are not is exactly what fits the definition of an interval scale, so ウ is correct.
fields.d:ア: “School year (grade)” can be put in order (a magnitude relation) as 1st year → 2nd year → 3rd year, but the difference between grades does not represent a fixed quantity, so the interval itself cannot be said to be meaningful. It corresponds to an ordinal scale, which only allows ordering, not an interval scale.
fields.d:イ: “Blood type” (A, B, O, AB) is merely a label for classification, with no order or magnitude relation, and computing differences or ratios is meaningless. It corresponds to a nominal scale, which only allows classification, not an interval scale.
fields.d:エ: “Sleep duration” has an absolute origin of 0 hours (absolute zero), and a ratio such as 4 hours being twice 2 hours is meaningful. Because not only differences but also ratios are meaningful, it corresponds to a ratio scale rather than an interval scale.
fields.p:0: Distinction among the four scales: nominal scale (classification only) < ordinal scale (ordering possible) < interval scale (differences are fixed and meaningful, but the origin is arbitrary) < ratio scale (has an absolute zero, so ratios are also meaningful). The higher the scale, the more operations are permitted.
fields.p:1: The decisive factor between an interval scale and a ratio scale is whether there is an absolute zero point and whether ratios are meaningful. Things like time of day and Celsius temperature, where differences are meaningful but ratios are not, are interval scales; things like length, weight, and duration, where ratios are meaningful, are ratio scales.
fields.stem: When data measurement scales are classified into the four types of nominal scale, ordinal scale, interval scale, and ratio scale, which of the following corresponds to an interval scale?

fields.correct: IoT (Internet of Things) is a mechanism that connects “things” embedded with sensors and the like to the internet to collect and make use of their status data. Option ウ gathers information from sensors installed on equipment in stores and factories over the internet, and has employees monitor the equipment status with a smartphone, which is exactly connecting real-world devices to a network to obtain and monitor data. This is a typical example of a system that uses IoT, so the correct answer is “ウ”.
fields.d:ア: A fundraising service that intermediates between an unspecified large number of borrowers and lenders over the internet is a financial service such as crowdfunding or social (peer-to-peer) lending, not IoT that connects things such as sensor devices.
fields.d:イ: Reading users sentiment from social media posts and call center conversation content is social listening and sentiment analysis that analyzes text and voice, an example of AI and big data utilization, not IoT that connects physical things to a network.
fields.d:エ: Providing internet-based storage for saving electronic files as a service is an example of cloud storage (a cloud service), and does not fall under IoT, which connects sensor-equipped things.
fields.p:0: IoT (Internet of Things) is a mechanism that connects things equipped with sensors and the like to the internet to collect, remotely monitor, and control their status data.
fields.p:1: Distinguish IoT from other IT services such as financial intermediation (social lending), sentiment analysis (big data / AI), and cloud storage, and grasp that the essence of IoT is connecting real-world devices to a network.
fields.stem: Which of the following is the most appropriate example of a system that utilizes IoT?
fields.c:ア: In fundraising, provide a service that intermediates between an unspecified large number of borrowers and lenders over the internet.
fields.c:イ: Analyze users' sentiment toward products or services based on social media posts, call center conversation content, and the like.
fields.c:ウ: Collect information from sensors installed on equipment in stores, factories, and the like over the internet, and have employees monitor the equipment's status using smartphones.
fields.c:エ: Provide internet-based storage for saving electronic files such as documents and images as a service.

audit_notes: イ と points[0]/[1] の「users business needs」「users role」「users involvement」で所有格のアポストロフィが抜けている (users' が正)。表記のみの問題。

fields.correct: System requirements definition decides what functions and data the business needs, so the involvement of the users who know the business best is essential. The users take on the role of joining the review of the system requirements compiled by the developer and confirming whether the requirements match their own business needs (validity). This lets misunderstandings or omissions in the requirements be found early and prevents rework in later processes. Therefore the answer is the option labeled A.
fields.d:イ: Leaving everything to the developer and following their decisions is wrong. Requirements definition is the process of reflecting the users business needs, and if the users do not get involved and hand it all over, the result is a system that does not fit the business, and agreement on the requirements cannot be reached.
fields.d:ウ: Determining whether the system can be maintained is wrong. Considering maintainability is a technical viewpoint handled by the developer side (engineers), so it is not the most appropriate way for the user to be involved.
fields.d:エ: Verifying technical feasibility is wrong. Verifying technical feasibility is the role of the developer (engineers). The user should be responsible not for the technical side but for confirming validity from the business side.
fields.p:0: In system requirements definition, the users role is to confirm through review that the requirements are consistent with the business needs (validity) and to form agreement on the requirements.
fields.p:1: Considering technical feasibility and maintainability is the role of the developer side, which is distinct from the users involvement.
fields.stem: In the development of a business system, when the developer carries out system requirements definition, which is the most appropriate way for the user to be involved?
fields.c:ア: Participate in the system requirements review conducted by the developer and confirm its validity.
fields.c:イ: Leave everything to the developer and follow their decisions.
fields.c:ウ: Determine whether the system can be maintained.
fields.c:エ: Verify the technical feasibility of the system requirements.

audit_notes: en 正解説明で引用符とアポストロフィが抜けている: "learns from things such as users past chat content" は "users' past chat content" とすべき。"the keywords learning and inference" にも引用符がない。表記上の問題だけで、意味は jp と一致している。

fields.correct: The correct answer is ア, AI. The question asks for a mechanism that learns from things such as users past chat content and can infer an appropriate answer from the flow of the conversation. The technology that learns rules and patterns from data and infers (reasons out) an appropriate output for unknown input is exactly AI (Artificial Intelligence). Here, a chatbot (automated-response software) using AI learns from the accumulated dialogue data and generates answers that fit the context, thereby replacing operator-based human handling with automated handling. Because the keywords learning and inference connect directly to the core functions of AI, ア is the most appropriate.
fields.d:イ: AR (Augmented Reality) is a technology that overlays computer-generated information or imagery onto a real-world scene. Its purpose is visual information augmentation, and it has nothing to do with the function of learning chat content and inferring answers, so it is incorrect.
fields.d:ウ: CRM (Customer Relationship Management) is a management approach or system that centrally manages customer information and transaction history and uses it for sales and support. Although it is a framework that supports customer handling, it is not itself a technology that learns from dialogue data and infers answers, so it does not fit this question and is incorrect.
fields.d:エ: ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) is a mechanism that integrates and manages the data of core business operations such as accounting, production, sales, and human resources in order to use management resources efficiently. Its purpose differs from chat automated response and from learning and inference, so it is incorrect.
fields.p:0: AI (Artificial Intelligence) is a technology that learns from large amounts of data to acquire patterns and can infer an appropriate output for unknown input; it forms the core of chatbot automated responses.
fields.p:1: AR = Augmented Reality, CRM = Customer Relationship Management, ERP = Enterprise Resource Planning. These are all frequently tested acronyms, and the key point is not to confuse their respective purposes and target domains.

In doing so, which of the following technologies is the most appropriate one used to change to a mechanism that learns from things such as the content of users' past chats and can infer an appropriate answer from the flow of the conversation?
